The hedge fund run by Bain Capital held 3,273 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.30M, up from 667 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Brookside Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc (Put) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $535.28B market cap company.
